slides.0.title: Steiermark
slides.0.subtitle: Südsteiermark, Vulkanland and Schilcher
slides.1.title: Three DACs (2018)
slides.1.highlights.0.title: The list
slides.1.highlights.0.content: Vulkanland Steiermark, Südsteiermark and Weststeiermark all became DACs in 2018
slides.1.highlights.1.title: Three tiers
slides.1.highlights.1.content: Each DAC has Gebietswein, Ortswein and Riedenwein tiers
slides.1.highlights.2.title: Climate
slides.1.highlights.2.content: About 5,100 ha in Steiermark (2024 data) with rainfall up to about 800 mm, wetter than the east
slides.1.content: Steiermark is among Austria's cooler, wetter major regions, known for aromatic whites.
slides.2.title: Weststeiermark and Schilcher
slides.2.highlights.0.title: Blauer Wildbacher
slides.2.highlights.0.content: Weststeiermark DAC adds Blauer Wildbacher, made into the high-acid rosé called Schilcher
slides.2.highlights.1.title: Südsteiermark
slides.2.highlights.1.content: Known for whites such as Sauvignon Blanc, Welschriesling, Morillon (Chardonnay) and Gelber Muskateller
slides.2.highlights.2.title: Vulkanland
slides.2.highlights.2.content: Named for its volcanic landscape, with aromatic whites such as Traminer as a feature (descriptive, not individually checked)
slides.2.content: Schilcher is a rosé, not a red; its high acidity is the hallmark.
In which year did the three Steiermark DACs begin?
All three Steiermark DACs date from 2018.
Which variety is Schilcher made from?
Schilcher is a rosé made from Blauer Wildbacher.
